title: Fix Event Mapping For Search
description: Fix wrong event mapping where search events are classified as code edit; should be search.
summary: Fixed three related bugs in event classification: (1) classifyCommandKind now returns ToolKindCodeSearch for sed/awk without -i flag, ToolKindCodeEdit only for sed -i; (2) shouldExecuteSearchCommand passes full segment with flags to classifyCommandKind instead of just binary name; (3) extractToolNameFromStdin now supports wrapped Cursor event format data.event.tool_name/name and data.event.input.command.
